name: Anna's Archive
description: FMHY 与全球学术界公认最大的开放知识与影子图书馆元搜索引擎，汇集并镜像了 Z-Library、Library Genesis、Sci-Hub 等数千万本图书与论文。
descriptionEn: The world's largest open shadow library search engine, uniting and preserving millions of books and research papers mirrored from Z-Library, LibGen, and Sci-Hub.
warningText: 完全公益非营利。下载时选择【Slow & Partner Downloads】无需任何充值捐助即可免费下载全本。警惕非官方仿冒打赏钓鱼站！
warningTextEn: Non-profit open catalog. Always click 'Slow & Partner Downloads' to download full books without payment. Beware of copycat phishing sites.

name: Z-Library
description: 全球规模最大的数字图书馆之一，收藏超过千万本出版图书与文献，支持多语言、格式转换并能通过官方 Telegram Bot 秒发到手机。
descriptionEn: One of the world's largest online libraries with 14M+ books and scholarly articles. Supports format conversion and delivery via official Telegram bots.
warningText: 严重避坑警告：国内搜索引擎上 90% 的 Z-Library 都是钓鱼套壳诈骗站，以充值 VIP 为名骗取费用！正版免费用户每天都有免费下载额度，请务必认准官方域名 singlelogin.re 或其官方 Telegram Bot。
warningTextEn: High Scam Warning: Search engines are flooded with fraudulent phishing clones demanding VIP subscription fees. Legitimate free users get daily quotas on singlelogin.re.

name: Legado (开源阅读)
description: Android 端公认最纯粹、体验最好的开源网络小说与出版物阅读器。无任何广告与推广，通过导入社区书源即可畅读全网。
descriptionEn: Acclaimed open-source Android book reader with custom source scrapers, rich typography controls, and zero internal advertisements.
warningText: 本体纯净开源且绝无内置广告。需在酷安或 GitHub Release 下载官方正版，并在网络上搜索导入‘开源阅读优质网络书源合集’。
warningTextEn: Clean open-source app with no proprietary tracking. Download official APKs from GitHub Releases and import community book rule feeds.

name: Koodo Reader
description: 跨平台高颜值开源电子书阅读器，支持 epub, pdf, mobi, azw3, txt 等 15+ 种格式，内置划线笔记、AI 翻译、多端 WebDAV 进度同步。
descriptionEn: Modern open-source e-reader supporting 15+ formats (EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, CBZ) with WebDAV cloud sync, text-to-speech, and translation.
warningText: 完全开源免费。支持网页版直接在浏览器打开阅读，或下载全平台桌面客户端使用。
warningTextEn: Completely free open-source. Usable directly in any web browser or installed as native desktop client.

name: Calibre
description: 全球电子书爱好者与极客首选的藏书管理中心，一键搞定格式转换、封面刮削、排版重构与无线推送到 Kindle/各类墨水屏阅读器。
descriptionEn: The essential open-source ebook manager. Batch convert file formats, scrape metadata and covers, and sync wirelessly with e-readers.
warningText: 纯粹的自由开源软件，持续维护数十年。遇到格式排版问题还可安装强大的 DeDRM 社区插件使用。
warningTextEn: Mature open-source staple maintained for decades. Compatible with third-party community plugins for format and DRM adjustments.
